Distinctive Programmes: The RV Integrated Programme (RV IP) offers a balanced education curriculum that develops every student's interests and talents to the fullest across the areas of academics, CCA and leadership. Our Leadership - Character Development Curriculum (LCDC) inculcates sound values and nurtures our students' character and leadership through programmes such as the Personal Leadership Programme, Overseas Experiential Learning Programme, Education and Career Guidance Week, National Education, Values in Action, RV Model United Nation (RVMUN) and our annual leadership seminar, Youth. Leverage Educate Actuate Develop (Y.LEAD). Our students will also get to develop their 21st century competencies, interest and talents through our CCA curriculum, where a range of sports, performing arts, uniformed groups, clubs and societies are made available to them. On the academic front, the Cognitive Interest Development Curriculum (CIDC), provides various academic talent development platforms such as the Bicultural Studies Programme & Bicultural Leaders Academy, the Science Leaders Academy, the Mathematics Leaders Academy, the Humanities and Social Studies Leaders Academy, the Eco-Sustainability Leaders Academy and the Student Leadership Development Academy. Most notably, our Construct, Integrate, Differentiate (CID) curriculum empowers our secondary students to be empathetic, innovative and critical thinkers who aspire to tackle real world problems. The academies, as well as the CID curriculum, allow our students to further develop their passion, interest and strength. In their 6 years with the school, all RVians will have the opportunity to develop and strengthen their civic literacy and global awareness through some of these cross cultural programmes, such as Y.LEAD, RVMUN, Overseas Experiential Learning Programme (OELP), Overseas Value-in-Action (OVIA), as well as international and local conferences such as the China Studies Perspective Forum.

Distinctive Programmes: SJI offers both the 4-year Secondary Education Certificate (SEC) Programme and a 6-year Integrated Programme (IP) leading to the International Baccalaureate (IB) Diploma at the end of the 6-year programme. An SJI education aims to educate the whole person by providing a broad-based academic curriculum that is integrated with a comprehensive student development curriculum emphasising character and leadership development. The SJI Education adopts a framework with 3-levels of Learning. Academic Foundations in Level 1 lays the foundations in core subjects such as English Language, Mother Tongue Languages, Humanities, Sciences, Mathematics and the Arts. Academic Extensions in Level 2 provides opportunities for students to further explore their areas of interest in specific subjects/topics. Sustained Inquiry and Thinking in Level 3 enables students to delve deeper into specific areas through sustained project work, including research work, or in innovative thinking programmes developed by SJI. Distinctive Programmes: Character & Citizenship Education (CCE) Our CCE programme is designed to allow students to develop a strong moral compass and for their voices to be heard. Whole-school CCE sharings are conducted, in tandem with class lessons, to highlight contemporary issues to raise awareness and generate buzz amongst the students. Education and Career Guidance (ECG) Our ECG programme facilitates a journey of self-discovery for students to know their strengths and interests. Our Industrial Attachment Programme gives students the opportunity to attain real-world work experience. Every student will develop a portfolio to serve as a self-driven guidance tool. Student Leadership (SL) Our SL development framework, TM WE SHINE, is the whole-school engagement of discovering self as a leader. All students undergo a course on foundational leadership skills and for those who have the desire to step-up to serve, they will undergo customised experiential training and a structured student-teacher mentorship. Talent Development (TL) The TL programme provides opportunities for outstanding students, mentored by a team of teachers, to develop essential qualities to be future leaders in various domains. Values in Action Our comprehensive service-learning programme encourages students to identify worthwhile causes which they are passionate about and take active steps to contribute to these causes. Guided by teachers and in collaboration with community partners, students carry out projects that serve the wider community. ExpLORE! This programme seeks to provide overseas opportunities for our students to Experience foreign cultures, Learn about emerging economies in the region, Observe unique societal issues, Reconnect with their Singaporean identity and Enrich the lives of others through service in overseas communities. Scholarships and Awards Besides MOE and external scholarships and awards, our College offers internal scholarships and awards that recognise our students' holistic accomplishments.

Distinctive Programmes: The TJC 6-Year Integrated Programme offers an enriched curriculum, which develops excellence in intellect, character and leadership through a wide range of activities, signature cohort programmes and MOE Elective programmes. Aesthetics Programme (Year 1 & 2) builds foundational literacy in various forms of aesthetic expression (Visual Art, Drama, Dance & Music). It nurtures critical thinking skills, imagination, collaborative skills, and confidence. Skills & Knowledge (Year 1 & 2) is a unique subject which combines computational thinking, media literacy & design thinking. Through this, students develop creative and critical thinking within the context of future-ready skills & dispositions. World without Borders (Year 2) builds on students' Skills & Knowledge foundation and further exposes them to ethnography. Students use these skills to investigate and understand the social, historical and geographical features of communities in Singapore. Innovation and Research Project (Year 3) focuses on Design Thinking methodology, which students apply to solve complex real-life problems. Wonder.Observe.Weave! (Year 4) allows students to gain valuable exposure through month-long attachments with external organisations. Temasek Academy (Year 1 to 4) is a talent development programme based on the Renzulli Enrichment Triad model. It stretches high-ability students in Mathematics, Science, English Language and Chinese Language through a range of activities, programmes, competitions and mentoring. Music Elective Programme (Year 1 to 6) offers an innovative and in-depth engagement in learning, performing and composing music, developing their skills and musical sensitivity. Chinese Language Elective Programme (Year 3 to 6) stimulates students' interest in Chinese language, literature and culture and nurtures excellence in Chinese language.
